title: Odd design - limited usefulness ...
text:
Odd design - limited usefulness .... I'm just not sure about these. I've used them over the past couple of weeks with mixed results. I think the problem is the fold between the "thumb" section and the "hand" section. I can't get a good grip on any pan no matter what the size or shape. These are OK for gripping the handle of a skillet (it's "narrow"), but trying to grip something even as thin as a pizza pan was nearly impossible, and a small roasting pan (7" x 11" x 2") took three tries and even then I didn't feel like I had a firm grip.

That said, these were well made with decent quality materials. The color, aqua, is a nice Caribbean aqua blue. No problems there.

As far as I can see, in my own kitchen, they have very limited use. I still have to rely on my "flat" potholders and larger oven mitts that have more of a "real" thumb section for grasping pans in the oven. These seem to work better on the stovetop. Three stars -- "just OK"
